violation_type.title: Healthy Environment - Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §742.801(a))
violation_type.short_title: Healthy Environment - Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have proper sanitation and maintenance.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have proper sanitation and maintenance.

A wading pool containing water had dirt on the floor of the wading pool. Wooden boards were observed on the playground and need to be made inaccessible to children. Rusted tools were observed on top of a wooden storage container. Cigarette butts were observed on the playground accessible to children.
